## Data Protection and Compliance — Compliance and Data Governance

### Regulatory framework
Thames Valley University is a UK institution. UK GDPR applies to the processing of student health data. HealthCore will act as a data processor. We will process health data only for the referral network program. Health data is special category data under Article 9 of UK GDPR. We will rely on explicit consent or substantial public interest as the lawful basis. We will provide only aggregate, de-identified program reports to the university. No individual health records will be shared with the client.

### Data Processing Agreement (DPA) under UK GDPR
We will include a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with UK GDPR Article 28. The DPA will cover data subject rights, breach notification, and data minimization. It will specify the lawful basis for processing health data. It will also include a 72-hour breach notification to the ICO. The DPA is mandatory for this engagement.

### Compliance approval
Compliance approval is mandatory before signing. Claire Whitfield, Chief Compliance Officer, must approve the final proposal and DPA. This step is not optional and cannot be waived.

### Open questions
- What specific health data categories will be processed (e.g., mental health records, vaccination status)?
- Will any data transfers occur outside the UK, and if so, what safeguards are in place?
- What is the retention period for the student health data?

## Clinical Delivery — Clinical Operations

### Sites and coverage

We will assign the HealthCore satellite clinic nearest to Thames Valley University’s main campus. Our UK network has three clinics: two in London (uk-lon-001, uk-lon-002) and one in Manchester (uk-man-001). We must confirm which location is closest and has current capacity to accept referrals for 3,000 students. The network must go live by August 28th. We will accelerate contracting and data-sharing setup to meet this deadline.

### Staffing and capacity

We cannot determine staffing requirements without the expected referral rate per student. This rate is unknown. We also need current staff availability at the chosen clinic. Once we have these data, we will calculate the number of GPs and specialists needed. We will then confirm capacity with the clinic manager.

### Clinical services

The referral network connects students to specialist care. We need the university to specify required clinical specialties. Common student needs include mental health and sexual health. All data handling complies with UK GDPR through a Data Processing Agreement (DPA). Our standard referral process targets 11 days from referral to confirmed appointment.

### Open questions

- What is the expected referral rate per student per month?
- Which satellite clinic is nearest to Thames Valley University’s main campus and has current capacity for additional referrals?
- What is the current staffing availability (clinician schedules, part-time vs full-time) at the identified clinic?
- What specific clinical specialties are required for student referrals?

## Clinical Delivery — Clinical Operations

### Sites and coverage

We will assign the HealthCore satellite clinic closest to Thames Valley University’s main campus. Our UK network has three clinics: two in London and one in Manchester. We need to confirm which location is nearest and has available capacity for 3,000 students. The network must be operational by August 28th. We will accelerate contracting and data-sharing setup to meet this timeline.

### Staffing and capacity

Staffing requirements depend on the expected referral volume. We do not have the university’s referral rate per student. We need this figure to calculate the number of GPs and specialists required. We also need to confirm current staff availability at the chosen clinic.

### Clinical services

The referral network will connect students to specialist care. We need the university to specify required clinical specialties. Common student needs include mental health and sexual health. All data handling will comply with UK GDPR through a Data Processing Agreement (DPA). Our standard referral process targets 11 days from referral to confirmed appointment.

### Open questions

- What is the expected referral rate per student per month?
- Which satellite clinic is nearest to the main campus and has current capacity?
- What is the current staffing availability at that clinic?
- What is the typical lead time for contracting and DPA execution?
- What specific clinical specialties are required for student referrals?

## Data Protection and Compliance — Compliance and Data Governance

### Regulatory framework
Thames Valley University is a UK institution. UK GDPR applies to the processing of student health data. HealthCore will act as a data processor. We will process health data only for the referral network program. Health data is special category data under Article 9 of UK GDPR. We will rely on explicit consent or substantial public interest as the lawful basis. We will provide only aggregate, de-identified program reports to the university. No individual health records will be shared with the client.

### Data Processing Agreement (DPA) under UK GDPR
We will include a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with UK GDPR Article 28. The DPA will cover data subject rights, breach notification, and data minimization. It will specify the lawful basis for processing health data. It will also include a 72-hour breach notification to the ICO. The DPA is mandatory for this engagement.

### Compliance approval
Compliance approval is mandatory before signing. Claire Whitfield, Chief Compliance Officer, must approve the final proposal and DPA. This step is not optional and cannot be waived.

### Open questions
- What specific health data categories will be processed (e.g., mental health records, vaccination status)?
- Will any data transfers occur outside the UK, and if so, what safeguards are in place?
- What is the retention period for the student health data?

covered_aspects: UK GDPR compliance for student health data
